udhaar.title: Udhaar (credit)
udhaar.body: The customer takes the item now and pays later, all or part of it. The app keeps what is left on his khata until he pays. In English software this is called "credit".
udhaar.example: Phone Rs. 50,000. He pays Rs. 20,000 now → Rs. 30,000 udhaar on his khata.

khata.title: Khata (account)
khata.body: One page per person (customer, dealer, other shop) with every bill and payment between you. It shows how much you will get from him or have to give him.
khata.example: Bilal's khata: bought on udhaar Rs. 30,000, paid Rs. 10,000 → you will get Rs. 20,000.

cost.title: Buying price
cost.body: What the shop paid for the item. Only the owner and the manager see it. Profit is worked out from it.
cost.example: You bought a phone for Rs. 45,000: the buying price is Rs. 45,000.

asking.title: Selling price
asking.body: The price you plan to sell at. It may not be lower than the buying price. At the counter you can still change it, and only the owner or manager can sell at a loss.
asking.example: Bought for Rs. 45,000, selling price Rs. 52,000.

profit.title: Profit
profit.body: Selling price minus buying price. "Profit after expenses" also takes away rent, bills, salaries and other expenses of that time.
profit.example: Sold for Rs. 52,000, bought for Rs. 45,000 → profit Rs. 7,000.

pta.title: PTA status
pta.body: PTA approved: the phone is registered in Pakistan and any SIM works. Non-PTA: not registered, a SIM works only for a short time. JV / patched: the phone has been changed to get around PTA; risky to buy and sell.
pta.example: An iPhone from abroad without PTA tax is Non-PTA.

imei.title: IMEI
imei.body: A 15-digit number that only that one phone has. Dial *#06# on the phone or look on the box. The app uses it to find the phone's history and to warn about stolen phones.

idcheck.title: ID card check
idcheck.body: When you buy a used phone from a customer, keep a photo of his CNIC and his face. If the phone turns out to be stolen, you can show who sold it to you. You may skip it for a person you know.
idcheck.example: Front and back of the CNIC, the seller's photo and a photo of the phone.

opening.title: Old stock
opening.body: Phones that were already in the shop before you started the app. Add them once so the stock is complete. No money is paid now, so the day's hisaab does not change.
opening.example: On the first day you add the 25 phones already on the shelf.

cut.title: Shop's cut on a return
cut.body: When a customer brings a phone back, the shop may keep part of the money and hand back the rest. What the shop keeps counts as income.
cut.example: Sold for Rs. 100,000, gives back Rs. 90,000 → the shop's cut is Rs. 10,000.

inHand.title: Left in hand
inHand.body: All money that came in minus all money that went out in that time (sales, payments, expenses, stock bought, refunds). Money spent on stock is now phones in the shop, so it is not a loss.
inHand.example: Came in Rs. 800,000, went out Rs. 750,000 → Rs. 50,000 left in hand.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.body: How long the shop will repair or replace the item if it has a fault. It is printed on the receipt.
warranty.example: 1 month warranty: any fault within a month is the shop's responsibility.

tid.title: TID
tid.body: Transaction ID: the number in the bank app or SMS after an online payment. Writing it helps you find the payment if there is a question later.

cheque.title: Cheque
cheque.body: Payment by a bank cheque. The money reaches the account only when the cheque clears, so the app keeps cheques in their own "Cheques" account.

remittance.title: Money from abroad
remittance.body: The buyer's family sends the money from another country (Western Union, bank and so on). Write how much came in their currency and the rate; the app works out the rupees.

void.title: Cancel a bill
void.body: Cancels a bill made by mistake. Nothing is deleted: the app adds an opposite entry, so the history and the hisaab stay correct.
void.example: A sale entered twice: cancel one of them.

landing.h1: Run your mobile shop from your phone
landing.sub: New and used phones, ID check of the seller, udhaar khata, repairs, accessories, WhatsApp receipts and the day's hisaab — in Urdu or English, big buttons, no training needed.
landing.waHello: Assalam-o-Alaikum, I want to know about the Mobile Shop software.

used.d: Buy from a walk-in with CNIC photos and the eGadget check, print the declaration, keep the phone's whole history by IMEI.

new.d: Stock by brand and model, box-pack and open-box, PTA / Non-PTA / JV with SIM time, tax on bills, invoices with your logo.

repair.d: Job sheets, parts and labour, status by WhatsApp, delivery with a bill — and accessories by count.

landing.videoSub: A sale, the stock list, the udhaar khata and the day's hisaab — recorded on the app itself.
landing.modulesSub: The basics come with every plan. The rest you add when you need it.

sale.d: Pick the phone, take the money (cash, online, cheque, from abroad or udhaar), print or WhatsApp the receipt.

purchase.d: From a dealer, a customer or another shop; IMEI by camera; box, charger and accessories recorded.

stock.d: Every phone, tablet and smart watch with its cost, asking price, condition and days in stock.

verify.d: CNIC scan fills the form; seller photo, eGadget result, signed declaration; stolen phones blocked.

khata.d: Who owes you and whom you owe, every bill and payment with the running balance.

payments.d: Cash, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash — each in its own account, day close with the drawer count.

invoices.d: Thermal receipt or A4 invoice in English or Urdu, PDF download and share.

returns.d: Take a phone back, cut a fee, give cash or credit; old phone in, new phone out.

hisaab.d: Sold, in hand, udhaar given, expenses and profit for today, this week or any dates.

staff.d: Owner, manager, salesman, technician — each sees only what they should; PIN and fingerprint login.

imei.d: Scan any IMEI: has this phone been here before, who sold it, who bought it.

languages.d: One language at a time, Nastaliq Urdu, right-to-left; printed papers follow the shop's language.

optional.accessories: Chargers, covers, cables, watches by count, with low-stock alerts.
optional.repairs: Job sheets, parts, labour, status on WhatsApp, delivery with a bill.
optional.expenses: Daily expenses by category, salaries, and closing the day.
optional.held_sales: Park a bill, serve the next customer, resume it later.
optional.tax: FBR sales tax on bills when the customer asks.
optional.exchange: Old phone in, new phone out, the difference settled in one go.
optional.reports: Profit and loss, best sellers, old stock, estimates — download or share.
optional.exports: Every report and invoice as PDF, Excel or CSV, shared on WhatsApp.
optional.notifications: Receipts to customers, udhaar reminders, the night report to the owner.
optional.loans: Phones given to another shop on amanat, tracked until they come back or are sold.

offline.d: Sales, stock and payments are saved on the phone and sent when the connection returns — posted once.

fingerprint.d: On the website and the Android app; staff too, when the owner allows.

cnic.d: A photo of the card fills the number, name, father's name and dates — read on the phone, nothing uploaded.

whatsapp.d: Receipts, reminders and reports go out on WhatsApp — automatically with the Business API.

data.q: Is my data safe? Can other shops see it?
data.a: No. Every shop's data is separate and backed up every night. Only your staff, with the roles you give them, can see your shop.

phone.a: No. It runs on any Android phone (app or browser) and on iPhone / laptop in the browser. A thermal printer is optional.

offline.a: Keep selling. Sales, stock and payments wait on the phone and are sent when the connection returns.

staff.q: Can my salesman see the buying price?
staff.a: Only if you want. Owner, manager, salesman and technician each see what you allow.

cancel.a: Yes. Pay month by month; your data stays yours and can be downloaded as Excel at any time.

landing.footer: Made in Pakistan for Pakistani mobile shops.
landing.webSub: The same shop in the browser on a laptop or desktop: a side menu with keyboard shortcuts (F2 sale, F3 add stock…), wide lists and reports. One login, every device.
